# Miqsat Ma'ase Ha-Torah Section 2 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Translator:** SOPHIA | **Source:** 4QMMT (4Q394–399, Cave 4), Section A continued + beginning of B | **Condition:** Fragmentary; reconstructed from multiple manuscripts

---

**2:1** [...the Festival of Weeks...] on the fifteenth of the [third] month [...] after the Sabbath [...]

**2:2** [...] You shall count seven complete Sabbaths from the day you bring the sheaf of the wave offering [...]

**2:3** [...] On the day after the seventh Sabbath you shall count [fifty days], and you shall bring a new grain offering to the LORD.

**2:4** [...] the Festival of First Fruits [...] the bread of the first fruits [...]

**2:5** The Festival of New Wine: on the third of the [fifth] month, after the Sabbath [...] you shall count from the day of the Festival of Weeks [...]

**2:6** [...] seven Sabbaths and two days [...] and you shall offer new wine upon the altar [...]

**2:7** [...] the first fruits of the wine [...] the priests shall dash the blood upon the altar [...]

**2:8** [...] the tithe of the wine [...] the Levites [...]

**2:9** [...] the Festival of New Oil [...] after the [Festival of New] Wine [...]

**2:10** The Festival of New Oil: on the twenty-second of the sixth month [...] after the Sabbath [...]

**2:11** [...] You shall count from the day of the Festival of [New] Wine seven Sabbaths and two days [...]

**2:12** [...] and you shall offer new oil upon the altar [...] the first fruits of the oil [...]

**2:13** [...] an offering by fire [...] a pleasing aroma to the LORD [...]

**2:14** [...] the Day of the Wood Offering [...] after the oil [...] the tribes [...]

**2:15** The Day of the Wood Offering: the leaders of the tribes [...] shall bring the wood for the altar [...]

**2:16** [...] the tribe of Levi first [...] the tribe of Judah [...] the tribe of Benjamin [...]

**2:17** [...] the tribe of the sons of Joseph: Ephraim and Manasseh [...]

**2:18** [...] the tribe of Reuben [...] the tribe of Simeon [...] and Issachar [...]

**2:19** [...] on the twenty-third of the sixth month [...] after the Festival of New Oil [...]

**2:20** And concerning [...] these are some of our rulings [...] concerning [...]

**2:21** [...] some of the works of the Torah which we consider for your good and for the good of your people [...]

**2:22** [...] for we saw in you wisdom and knowledge of the Torah [...]

**2:23** Consider these things [...] and ask Him to direct your counsel aright [...]

**2:24** [...] and to keep far from you evil scheming and the counsel of Belial [...]

**2:25** [...] these are some of the matters concerning which we have written to you [...]

---

*SOPHIA notes: SOPHIA follows LOGOS for most of this section, as the calendar terminology and festival names are best served by formal English. "Festival of Weeks" is preferred over PNEUMA's "Harvest Festival" because the Hebrew name Shavu'ot literally means "Weeks" and the counting formula is integral to the text. "Sabbaths" is retained in the counting formula (against PNEUMA's "weeks") because the Hebrew is explicitly shabbatot. "Works of the Torah" preserves the phrase that gives the document its name (miqsat ma'ase ha-torah). The transition to Section B signals the document's polemical purpose: a halakhic letter disputing practices with the Jerusalem priesthood.*
